relationships.lambert-rabe: Companion and fellow Baltic crisis veteran.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Indirect sword influence; Ikki studied his recordings and recognizes him.

relationships.fu-xiaoli: Defeats him and thanks him as a good opponent.

periods.summary: Kiba is introduced at Edelberg as Sword Wolf, a former Japanese top-ranked knight who disappeared fifteen years earlier after reaching world rank twelve. Ikki recognizes him as one of the swordsmen whose records helped shape his own sword study. Kiba and Lambert Rabe both fought in the Baltic crisis and have come to challenge Edelweiss again after careful preparation. When Fu Xiaoli appears, Kiba insists on fighting her alone, deploys Demon Ice Ten-Wolf Formation with nine ice clones, and attempts an absolute-zero killing slash; Xiaoli breaks through and counters, leaving him frozen and broken but alive.

key_events.summary: Meets Stella's party at the foot of Edelberg and warns about Edelweiss.
Is defeated by Xiaoli's martial superiority despite his ice clone formation.
